metadata.title: When your ONE kill feels like a glitch in VALORANT... did I just hack the matrix?
metadata.description:
Wait, I got a kill? Must be a bug.
Watch me act like I planned this madness.
VALORANT logic strikes again.
Click if your aim’s on vacation but luck saves you!

Tap to see pure luck break VALORANT’s rules!

#valorant #luckygamer #gamingfails #funnyclips #shorts
